Frontend E2E via Playwright: admin/settings/sms shows all three admin-setting-reminder-* fields — typed values persist across PUT+reload (200 OK). /provider dashboard shows both provider-manage-staff and provider-schedule-grid cards side-by-side. /provider/schedule-grid renders [data-testid=schedule-grid] with grid-row-{staff_id} for both Cardio + Neuro, exactly 7 grid-cell-{sid}-{jsDay} cells per row, 7 grid-add-{sid}-{jsDay} buttons per row, and grid-copy-{sid}-1/2 (Mon/Tue) for Cardio which has existing shifts. grid-add-modal opens with grid-form-start/end/slot/max and grid-form-save — save fires POST /api/providers/me/staff/{id}/availability → 200. grid-copy-modal opens with 7 grid-copy-target-* buttons and grid-copy-confirm; source-day button is properly disabled. BookingDetail /bookings/{id} for the customer's confirmed booking renders [data-testid=booking-queue-position] as the prominent pill ('🟢 You’re up next!' for position 0). useLivePolling is active (~7 network fetches observed over ~9s while the tab is visible, ~4s cadence).

minor.issue: Server does not merge SmsSettings() defaults over legacy stored docs. If the settings row was created before iter41, GET omits reminder_template_id/reminder_var_ahead/reminder_var_name until the first PUT — frontend then renders empty strings for the new inputs on first load (harmless, self-heals on Save). Recommend spreading `{**SmsSettings().model_dump(), **doc}` on GET so the new keys always surface.

ui_bugs.issue: For active (pending/confirmed) bookings that are NOT on today's date, /queue/my-position returns `{has_booking:false}`; the fallback `Math.max(0, 0 - 0 - 1) = 0` sets queuePos.position=0 and the prominent pill shows '🟢 You’re up next!' even though the appointment is days away. This misleads customers. Recommend guarding: only set queuePos when qp.has_booking === true AND qp.booking?.id === b.id, otherwise leave queuePos=null so the pill hides for future-dated bookings.

issues: '· Auto-refreshing every 4s' hint sits inside the same block that also gates on `queuePos.current_token != null`. When has_booking=false today, current_token stays null and the hint never renders — losing the reassurance UX. Move the auto-refresh hint outside the current_token conditional (still under isActive) so it always shows while polling.

action_items: (MEDIUM) In BookingDetail, do NOT show 'You’re up next!' pill for bookings not scheduled for today — gate on qp.has_booking===true AND qp.booking.id===b.id before setQueuePos.
(LOW) On GET /api/admin/settings/sms, merge stored doc over SmsSettings() defaults so legacy rows still surface the new reminder_* keys on first load.
(LOW) Move 'Auto-refreshing every 4s' hint out of the current_token-null conditional so the reassurance is always visible while useLivePolling is running.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3083 lines — split into routers is still overdue.

/queue/my-position uses `token_number > 0` in the ahead filter, which correctly excludes tokens that were never assigned; but ALSO silently returns wait=0 whenever the customer's own token_number is 0 (unassigned) — consider surfacing a distinct state instead of implying zero people ahead.

HospitalScheduleGrid.jsx Copy modal POSTs one availability rule per (source_shift × target_day) — verified once via UI, but there is no client-side dedupe; if the target day already contains an identical shift, the backend will happily create a duplicate row. Consider skipping targets where an equivalent shift already exists.

Admin SMS Settings save flow uses PUT /api/admin/settings/sms (Pydantic strict) — if the stored doc predates iter41, GET may return without new fields; the UI defensively defaults to '' but future field additions will require the same care.
